skill.name: adaptyv
skill.description: Use Adaptyv to prepare cloud laboratory workflows for protein validation assays. The skill explains API authentication, experiment submission, status tracking, result retrieval, and sequence optimization references.
skill.summary: Guides Adaptyv API workflows for protein assay submission, tracking, results, and sequence optimization.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill is mostly documentation and examples for a declared protein-testing API. Most secret, reconnaissance, and shell-execution flags are false positives, but the content does instruct outbound submissions to an opaque AWS Lambda endpoint and local result-file writes. No prompt injection evidence was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Opaque API endpoint receives authenticated submissions.
remediation.suggestion: Use a documented Adaptyv-owned API domain, or clearly document endpoint provenance and require user confirmation before use.

remediation.issue: Protein sequences and metadata are sent to external services.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit privacy guidance and require user approval before submitting confidential biological data.

remediation.issue: Examples use bearer tokens for API authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Keep tokens in environment variables or a secrets manager, and add checks that reject placeholder or missing tokens.

remediation.issue: Result examples write files using dynamic names and directories.
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize experiment identifiers and restrict output paths to user-approved directories.

semantic_findings.title: Opaque External API Endpoint Receives Tokens and Sequences
semantic_findings.description: The skill routes authenticated experiment submissions to a raw AWS Lambda URL instead of a clearly branded Adaptyv domain. The same examples attach bearer tokens and protein sequences, so users cannot verify endpoint ownership from the skill content alone.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly combine an unbranded AWS Lambda host with bearer authentication and sequence submission. The files do not provide independent proof that the endpoint is controlled by Adaptyv.

content.value_statement: Protein teams need clear workflows for outsourced wet-lab validation. This skill guides Adaptyv API setup, assay submission, tracking, and result review.
actual_capabilities: Explains Adaptyv API authentication with ADAPTYV_API_KEY.
Shows how to submit single and batch FASTA experiments.
Covers binding, expression, thermostability, and enzyme activity assays.
Guides experiment status checks, result retrieval, and webhook use.
Describes optimization references for NetSolP, SoluProt, SolubleMPNN, and ESM.
Includes examples for retry handling and FASTA validation.
limitations: Requires Adaptyv API access and a valid account.
Uses external APIs, so users must verify endpoint ownership and data policies.
Does not run wet-lab experiments inside the assistant.
Results timing depends on the provider and is described as about 21 days.

use_cases.title: Submit Protein Variants
use_cases.description: Prepare FASTA sequences, choose assay types, and submit validation jobs through the Adaptyv API.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Optimized Sequences
use_cases.description: Review solubility and naturalness checks before selecting variants for wet-lab testing.

use_cases.title: Track Lab Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan status polling, webhook notifications, and result download steps for ongoing experiments.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Access
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new account.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up an Adaptyv API workflow with ADAPTYV_API_KEY, required packages, and a connection check.

prompt_templates.title: Submit One Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an Adaptyv submission plan for one protein sequence, including FASTA formatting, assay type, and metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Run Batch Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a batch Adaptyv validation workflow for these variants, with metadata, target details, and status tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Before Testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an end-to-end workflow that screens sequences for solubility, selects top candidates, and submits them to Adaptyv.

output_examples.input: Plan a binding assay for three antibody variants against a known target.
output_examples.output: The response outlines FASTA preparation, target metadata, binding assay selection, submission steps, and follow-up status checks.

output_examples.input: Compare sequence optimization checks before expression testing.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes solubility predictors, residue constraints, naturalness checks, and candidate selection criteria.

output_examples.input: Explain how to retrieve completed Adaptyv results.
output_examples.output: The response describes status lookup, result download planning, local file naming, and webhook-based notification handling.

best_practices: Verify endpoint ownership before sending API keys or proprietary sequences.
Store API tokens in environment variables or a secrets manager.
Validate FASTA content and metadata before submitting experiments.
anti_patterns: Submit confidential sequences without legal and data-handling approval.
Hard-code API keys or webhook secrets in prompts, notebooks, or repositories.
Poll long-running experiments aggressively instead of using webhooks or backoff.

faq.question: Do I need an Adaptyv account?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes API workflows that require approved Adaptyv access and a valid token.

faq.question: Which assay types are covered?
faq.answer: The references cover binding, expression, thermostability, and enzyme activity assays.

faq.question: Does this skill require network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples send requests to external laboratory and prediction services.

faq.question: Can it design new proteins by itself?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare optimization and validation workflows for sequences you provide.

faq.question: How long do results take?
faq.answer: The skill documentation says Adaptyv results are typically delivered in about 21 days.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential sequences?
faq.answer: Only after users verify endpoint ownership, provider agreements, and internal approval for external submission.
